comparison.objective: Pull a segmented cable to a 30 cm mark, hand it over as needed, and leave it straight.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handoff, controlled pulling to length, and management of a flexible chain without kinks or over-pull.
comparison.success_condition: Released cable lies straight within length tolerance; excessive pull, lift, lateral deviation, or fixture movement invalidates.
comparison.reason: This tests deformable-cable measurement and handoff, not rigid-body tool impact, fracture, retained insert protection, or fragment containment.
